ghats.name: Pampa River Foothills Boating & Ghat Point
ghats.description: Encircles the sacred Ratnagiri hill and touches the feet of the hillock; features peaceful boating facilities and sacred waters located ~2 km via the ghat road from the temple.

safety_rules: Pilgrims must exercise caution while taking holy baths or using boat services, particularly during monsoon and festival peak flows.
significance: Like all sacred Divyakshetrams surrounded by holy rivers, Lord Sri Satyanarayana Swamy at Annavaram is encircled by the holy Pampa River touching the feet of Ratnagiri. Every year on Karthika Suddha Dwadasi, the sacred Theppotsavam (Boat Festival) is celebrated on the Pampa River with great religious fervor.
